items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: So for instance, one guy who is a friend of mine, Leon Rainey.

ctx.x: Well, in some instances I have been told this. But, as I say, it depends on how they, you know, what the contract is, and of course this all goes back to a union thing. By the time -- you see, by the time all this happened, naturally I was into the union, you see, thanks to Paul Howard, got me involved in -- well, I had been in the union years, because I had been out here quite awhile when this all happened. So it was quite a marvelous thing. However, I must say that when it did -- when the opportunity did come,…

get excited, I wasn't excited, you know, because I had been promised -- I had had interviews and I had spoken to people and been recommended to people. But none of this happened -- it didn't happen when I expected it to happen. You understand what I'm saying? So for instance, one guy who is a friend of mine, Leon Rainey. You know the René brothers, Leon and Otis René?
